observation.command:
cd /tmp
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
ACTION=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' page.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"$//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
echo "action=${ACTION:0:120}..."
curl -s -c cj.txt -b cj.txt -L -D h3.txt -o final.html \
  --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "credentialId=" \
  "$ACTION"
echo "=== final redirects ==="; grep -i '^Location:' h3.txt | tail -5
echo "=== final body title ==="; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' final.html | head -1; echo "bytes: $(wc -c < final.html)"
echo "=== does final look like app html? ==="; grep -o 'SPARK Workflow\|id="app"' final.html | head -3
